# Moonoh (moon-oh.com) — Local Commerce Discovery & Market Intelligence
# Format: https://llmstxt.org
# Last Updated: 2026-08-20

> Moonoh is a verified local commerce discovery platform across New York City (Manhattan, Brooklyn, Queens, Bronx, Staten Island) and New Jersey. Moonoh combines peer-to-peer neighborhood listings, curated local boutique inventory, community marketplaces, and sustainable food rescue.

## Core Platform Summary
- Total Catalog Index: 5,178 listing URLs
- Active Live Inventory: 4,228 currently tracked, renderable items
- Commission / Fees: 0% seller fees on peer-to-peer neighborhood listings

## Live Marketplace
- Explore All NYC & NJ: https://moon-oh.com/explore
- Manhattan Marketplace: https://moon-oh.com/explore/manhattan
- Brooklyn Marketplace: https://moon-oh.com/explore/brooklyn
- Queens Marketplace: https://moon-oh.com/explore/queens
- Food Rescue: https://moon-oh.com/explore/food-rescue
- NYC Local Shops: https://moon-oh.com/explore/local-shops

## Local Market Intelligence & Historical Reports
Moonoh captures daily market pulses (active listings, median price via NIST/R-7 quantiles, IQR, category distribution) and publishes immutable bi-weekly observational reports.
- Manhattan Historical Hub: https://moon-oh.com/reports/manhattan
- Brooklyn Historical Hub: https://moon-oh.com/reports/brooklyn
- Queens Historical Hub: https://moon-oh.com/reports/queens
- Manhattan Baseline Report: https://moon-oh.com/reports/manhattan/2026-08-20

## Inventory Composition
1. Moonoh Direct P2P: 597 items
2. NYC Local Specialty Shops: 2,215 products (Front General Store, SEY Coffee, Salter House, Big Night, Pop Up Grocer, Mirth Vintage)
3. Community Marketplaces: 1,401 items (Karrot & HeyKorean)
4. Food Waste Rescue: 15 items (Kim'C Market)

## Statistical Methodology
- Quantile Calculation: R-Type 7 / NIST Linear Interpolation Quantiles.
- Price Population: $0/free items counted separately and excluded from median/IQR calculations.
- Geographic Scoping: Physical 'Located in' location strictly determines regional statistics.
